notes.content:
Hi Tetherheads! We just popped out a new build of the game for some quality-of-life improvements, plus some fun VO.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Reduced memory need per frame to improve performance and eliminate hitching after hours of gameplay
[*] Added voice acting
[*] Fixed bugs introduced by some code refactoring
[*] Added kiosk/attract mode
[*] Removed issue with tether force dependence on framerate
[*] Enabled vsync
[/list]
